name: circuits
description: Monorepo for Circuits — live queries for Postgres: a Rust engine ingests logical replication and keeps every query result (joins, aggregates, subqueries) in sync, speaking the Electric protocol plus an extended API.

scripts.test:durable-streams:conformance: cargo build --profile release-durable-streams -p durable-streams && bun run --cwd apps/durable-streams test:conformance
